units.text: For many years, I had the privilege of overseeing this site. Communities like Citi's demonstrate the extraordinary power of people showing up for one another. Please continue to take care of one another. Photo Caption: Citi Tampa has always been a tremendous force for good in the community.

frames.quote: Citi Tampa has always been a tremendous force for good
Please continue to take care of one another

units.text: I ask that we all look out for one another. Additional security. Counseling and other resources available.

frames.quote: I ask that we all look out for one another

units.text: This afternoon we shared with our colleagues that Citi will be making a $250,000 contribution in honor of LeAnne Selman.
LeAnne Selman loved music and animals. Citi will be giving $250,000. We're grateful to our security team for their professionalism and bravery.

frames.quote: LeAnne Selman loved music and animals
grateful to our security team for their professionalism and bravery

units.text: There are threats that come in frequently. Our security team was changing their security posture as the event was starting.

frames.quote: changing their security posture as the event was starting

units.text: It's really important for us to recognize the traumatic events that our colleagues experienced.

frames.quote: recognize the traumatic events that our colleagues experienced

units.text: I was equally grateful to receive a personal call from one of the leaders in my organization.
